import re

def parse(lines):
    deps = []
    dl = []
    vers = []
    vl = []
    skip = []
    obj = None
    inver = False
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        s = l.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if s == 'Version information:':
            inver = True
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if inver:
            m = re.match(r'^(?P<lib>\S+)\s+\((?P<ver>[^)]*)\)(?:\s+=>\s+(?P<path>.*))?$', s)
            if m:
                vers.append({'object': obj or '', 'library': m.group('lib'), 'version': m.group('ver'), 'path': m.group('path') or ''})
                vl.append(i)
                continue
            if s.endswith(':'):
                obj = s[:-1]
                vl.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(?P<lib>\S+)(?:\s+=>\s+(?P<path>.*?))?(?:\s+\((?P<addr>0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)\))?$', s)
        if m:
            deps.append({'library': m.group('lib'), 'path': m.group('path') or '', 'address': m.group('addr') or ''})
            dl.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if deps:
        blocks.append({'name': 'dependencies', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': dl, 'records': deps})
    if vers:
        blocks.append({'name': 'version_information', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': vl, 'records': vers})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
